criteria.name: Circuit, scenery and environmental presentation

criteria.name: Keyboard driving and handling

criteria.name: Independent interacting NPC opponents

criteria.name: Vehicle, barrier and obstacle collisions
criteria.reason: No collisions.

criteria.name: Three usable race cameras

criteria.name: Validated laps, timing, positions and finish

criteria.name: Menus, HUD, instructions and interface hierarchy
